title: %or — boolean OR
purpose: Return true when either condition is truthy.
notes: Both operands are %eq verb-expressions producing booleans.
Exactly two operands; nest %or for additional alternatives.

avoid.why: the quoted infix expressions are inert literal strings — not truthy — so %or returns ?false and the rule never fires. Build each side from a comparison verb like %eq @.role "admin".
